correctness.rationale: For G=C16(1,4,8) on Z/16Z, checked every one of 2^16 vertex subsets and reconstructed the exact face vectors K=(1,16,80,144,80), D=(1,15,70,117,60), L=(1,10,27,20,0). An independent Python matching implementation found for D 129 nonempty matched pairs, critical cells (one 0, two 2, one 3), all 731 directed nonempty cover relations acyclic, and exact signed Morse boundary (-1,0)^T. Hence D≃S² by integral CW cancellation. For L: 26 matched pairs, one 0, one 1, three 2, 114 acyclic directed covers, signed Morse boundary (1,0,1), giving L≃S²∨S². Existing Earl et al. full-complex shelling and computed Euler characteristic imply K≃S³; Mayer–Vietoris for K=D∪(v*L) gives a split primitive surjection H2(L)=Z²→H2(D)=Z. The rotations cover all 16 vertices. Verified the earlier primitive top cycle: 80 tetrahedra, 64 unit and 16 double coefficients, with 16 unit and 4 double tetrahedra incident at each vertex. No leap from mod-two ranks to integral homotopy was made.
residual_risks: The full-complex shellability premise is from a published primary theorem, not reproved by this independent script.
The finite self-contained proof is for exactly C16(1,4,8), not a family of larger circulants; no Lean/expert attestation is claimed.

value.rationale: The exact vertex deletion of the canonical minimal shellable but nonvertexdecomposable circulant is a natural local-topology test, not an arbitrary small slice. Its integral S² homotopy type and primitive Z²→Z map explain more than the known non-Cohen–Macaulay h-vector: one vertex-link generator survives deletion and one accounts for the ambient 3-sphere attaching class. At original public priority it was an independently motivated exact topological invariant beyond the earlier partial local-link classification. It is finite but complete and mathematically meaningful; it does not pretend to classify other circulants or offer new novelty over later overlapping top-cycle findings.
residual_risks: Its significance is local to this 16-vertex benchmark, not an infinite family.
After later November 8 publications it is also a corollary by standard topological tools; value assessment specifically credits the original earlier contribution, not a new general method.
